strings.name: Son Heung-min
strings.summary: Son progressed through German youth football to elite European leagues, becoming a Tottenham figure through speed, two-footed finishing and movement. In 2021–22 he became the first Asian Premier League Golden Boot winner. As captain he helped Spurs win the 2025 Europa League before joining Los Angeles FC. His long South Korea career and work across continents broadened Asian players' international visibility.

strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in Chuncheon, Gangwon, South Korea.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Asian Premier League Golden Boot
strings.highlights.h1.text: Shared the 2021–22 award with Salah after scoring twenty-three goals.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and early training
strings.facts.f2.value: Trained under father Son Woong-jung before entering Hamburg's academy at sixteen.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Tottenham's Europa League title
strings.highlights.h2.text: Captained the club to end its long trophy wait in 2025.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Addresses national-team differences
strings.timeline.t1.text: Said differences with teammates had been resolved and stressed setting an example for younger players.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joins Los Angeles FC
strings.timeline.t2.text: Moved to MLS after ten years at Tottenham.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Europa League victory
strings.timeline.t3.text: Led Spurs to a final victory over Manchester United.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becomes Tottenham captain
strings.timeline.t4.text: Succeeded Hugo Lloris in the team's leading role.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Shared Premier League Golden Boot
strings.timeline.t5.text: Twenty-three season goals made him the first Asian winner.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Puskás Award
strings.timeline.t6.text: His long solo run against Burnley won FIFA's annual goal award.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Asian Games gold
strings.timeline.t7.text: Helped South Korea win the Jakarta–Palembang men's football tournament.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Tottenham
strings.timeline.t8.text: Moved from Leverkusen to England for a ten-year club chapter.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Leverkusen transfer
strings.timeline.t9.text: Continued developing in Germany's top division and European competition.
strings.timeline.t10.title: Bundesliga debut
strings.timeline.t10.text: Entered senior top-flight football with Hamburg.
